title: serpyllum vulgare
intro: Serpyllum vulgare, commonly known as Wild Thyme, is a flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties that can aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and soothe skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Wild Thyme include its ability to act as a natural expectorant, antispasmodic, and carminative, making it useful for treating coughs, sore throats, and indigestion. The bioactive constituents of Wild Thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-cancer activities.
